**The Gauss Map and a Noncompact Riemann-Roch Formula for Constructible Sheaves on Semiabelian Varieties**

*J. Franecki, M. Kapranov*

9 pp, 9 sections.

**Abstract.** For an irreducible subvariety Z in an algebraic group G we deﬁne an integer gdeg(Z) ≥0 as the degree, in a certain sense, of the Gauss map of Z. It can be regarded as a substitution for the intersection index of the conormal bundle to Z with the zero section of T ∗G, even though G may not be compact. For G a semiabelian variety (in particular, an algebraic torus (C∗)n), we prove a Riemann- Roch type formula for constructible sheaves on G which involves our substitutions for the intersection indicies. As a corollary, we get that a perverse sheaf on such a G has nonnegative Euler characteristic, generalizing a theorem of Loeser-Sabbah.
